Cena Consumer Terms of Service

Effective date: [DATE] · Operator: [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME] · Contact: [MAILING ADDRESS] · [SUPPORT EMAIL]

These terms govern your use of the Cena app and related services (the “Service”) to browse meal kits offered by participating restaurants and place orders for pickup. By creating an account, placing an order, or using the Service, you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

1. What Cena provides

Cena displays meal kits, descriptions, ingredients or other menu information supplied by participating restaurants, pickup details, and order status. Each restaurant is responsible for preparing and supplying its meal kits and for the accuracy and completeness of its menu and allergen information. Cena is a marketplace and ordering interface; unless a screen says otherwise, Cena does not prepare or sell the food.

New orders are paid online in Cena through Stripe-hosted Checkout; pay-at-pickup is not available for new orders. Stripe collects and processes your card details through its hosted checkout page and sends Cena payment status and reference information. Cena does not receive or store full card numbers. The restaurant is the seller of the food and receives payment through its own connected Stripe account, less Cena’s disclosed flat fee of $1.50–$2.00 per paid order and any applicable Stripe processing fees. Review the order details and total shown at checkout before authorizing payment. A submitted order remains subject to the restaurant’s acceptance, availability, and the order details shown in the app. The app will show whether an order is confirmed, its pickup location, and pickup window. Do not travel until the app shows confirmation.

2. Your account and information

You must provide accurate account information and keep your login credentials secure. You are responsible for activity through your account and must promptly tell us at [SUPPORT EMAIL] if you believe it has been accessed without permission. You may update optional profile details, including phone number and kitchen equipment preferences, or request account deletion through the app or the privacy request form in our Privacy Policy.

You must be legally able to enter these Terms. The Service is not directed to children under 13; do not create an account if you are under 13. If you are under the age of majority where you live, use the Service only with a parent or guardian’s permission.

3. Orders, pickup, and food information

Review the restaurant, item, quantity, pickup location, pickup window, and total due at Stripe Checkout before authorizing payment. A restaurant may reject or cancel an order if an item is unavailable, the restaurant cannot fulfill it, or circumstances change. We or the restaurant will use the contact information or in-app notices available to communicate a cancellation or material change.

Arrive during the stated pickup window and follow the restaurant’s pickup instructions. If you cannot collect an order, contact the restaurant using the details shown in the app. Each restaurant sets and discloses its cancellation, missed-pickup, refund, and food-remedy practices and is responsible for fulfillment and refund decisions. Approved refunds are processed through Stripe to the original payment method, subject to provider processing times and applicable law. Nothing in these Terms limits rights that cannot legally be waived.

Menu, ingredient, nutrition, and allergen details are supplied by restaurants and may be incomplete or change. Contact the restaurant directly before ordering if you have an allergy, dietary restriction, or food-safety question. Do not rely on the app as a guarantee that a meal is free from an allergen or suitable for a specific diet.

4. Acceptable use

Use the Service only for lawful personal ordering. Do not misuse the Service, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, submit false or fraudulent orders, scrape or copy listings at scale, or use another person’s account without permission. We may investigate suspected misuse and restrict or suspend access when reasonably needed to protect users, restaurants, Cena, or the Service.

5. Restaurant relationship

The restaurant—not Cena—is responsible for preparing and handing over the food, food safety, licensing, allergen and menu disclosures, pickup operations, fulfillment, and refund decisions. Your purchase of food is with the restaurant. Online payments are processed through Stripe for the restaurant’s connected account; Cena receives payment statuses and references, not full card numbers. Cena is not responsible for a restaurant’s acts or omissions, except to the extent applicable law says otherwise. Please raise food quality, fulfillment, or pickup concerns with the restaurant and contact [SUPPORT EMAIL] for help with app, order-display, or payment-status issues.

6. Service changes and availability

We may change, suspend, or discontinue a feature, restaurant listing, or the Service. We may suspend access for a breach of these Terms or to address security, legal, or operational concerns. We will make reasonable efforts to provide notice when a material change affects an active confirmed order. We do not promise uninterrupted or error-free operation.

7. Intellectual property and feedback

Cena and its licensors retain rights in the Service, software, branding, and content Cena creates. Restaurants retain rights in their submitted names, menus, photographs, and other materials. You may use the Service for its intended personal purpose and may not reproduce or commercially exploit its content without permission. If you send feedback, you allow Cena to use it without restriction or payment, but this does not transfer ownership of your personal information.

8. Disclaimers and limits

To the extent permitted by law, the Service is provided “as is” and “as available.” Cena does not warrant restaurant menus, food, availability, or uninterrupted app operation. To the extent permitted by law, Cena will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or loss of profits or data. To the extent permitted by law, Cena’s total liability arising from the Service or these Terms will not exceed the greater of (a) amounts you paid to Cena for the Service in the 12 months before the event, or (b) US $100. These limits do not apply where prohibited by law, or to liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

9. Disputes and governing law

Contact us first at [SUPPORT EMAIL] so we can try to resolve a concern informally. These Terms are governed by the laws of [STATE], without regard to conflict-of-law principles, except where mandatory law in your place of residence applies. Courts located in [COUNTY, STATE] will have jurisdiction, subject to any non-waivable consumer rights and venue rules. No arbitration, class-action waiver, or fee-shifting term is included in this draft.

10. General

If a provision is unenforceable, the rest remains effective to the extent the law permits. A failure to enforce a provision is not a waiver. You may not transfer these Terms without our consent; we may transfer them as part of a business reorganization or sale, subject to applicable law. These Terms, together with the Privacy Policy and any terms expressly incorporated in the app, are the agreement between you and Cena about the Service. We may update these Terms by posting a revised version with a new date; for material changes, we will provide notice through the app or another reasonable method. Continued use after the effective date means you accept the revised Terms.

11. Contact

Questions or concerns: [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME], [MAILING ADDRESS], [SUPPORT EMAIL].
